measurement_notes: Process list and CPU counters are namespace-visible, not proof that the host had no other workloads.
No concurrent browser/build was intentionally started by this verification team.
Each npm run check includes lint, typecheck, build, Node and Vitest.
Existing assertions and package registration are retained; added N2 cases and Q1 responsibility split are documented. The 5000ms limit is unchanged.
Synthetic parser negative controls passed; they are not product tests.
